_about: Shared kit parts on the Sunfish (Tools/boatkit/bk_parts.py), placed by build_fleet.py's place_kit. Body frame metres (+y starboard); on: deck, sole (the cockpit well's floor) or z; mirror: also at -y; yaw degrees about Z; flip: hung upside down. Replaces the hand-built halyard cleat and mainsheet block (Boats 11).
